change.controller: reconcile_once reads cron.runs for a job only when cron.list state.lastRunAtMs/lastRunStatus differs from the last consumed watermark; no watermark (first pass/restart) or no state -> reads once as before; watermark is not advanced while a one-run-per-pass backlog remains or on failure
change.registrar_scope_extension: reconcile_daily_cycles skips readback/cleanup cron.list calls when the single matching job is already exact (previously 3 extra cron.list per persona per pass) and returns job_states from the one list read; mutation paths unchanged

before.calls_per_pass_code_actual: 1 + 3 + 3 (registrar readback/final lists per persona) = 10 ... plus cron.runs per persona

after.plus_run_reads: about 3 cron.runs per day (one per persona after its daily run)

runtime_budget_three_personas.per_call_cost: one adapter openclaw Node CLI spawn, about 400 MiB for 5-7 s

new: no-state payload falls back to cron.runs
